current best evidence based inputs\u003C\/i\u003E.\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECheif complaint:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA haemodialysis\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of present illness \u0026nbsp; 10 yrs back _ he had fever , difficulty in having food and was taken to hospital and incidentally found to have Diabetes mellitus And started on conservative management\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3yrs back_ Pedal edema , facial puffiness( no treatment was taken for it)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2 yrs back_ Taken to local RMP And was diagnosed to have renal failure Used conservative medication (but it wasn't not controlled )\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E15 days back _ there is Decreased apettite , vomiting ,nausea, facial puffiness, pedal edema, Distention of abdomen , decresed Urine output\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of past illness
